name: reptclip-for-vscode
description: Paste your project as clean Markdown context into a free Chatbot, and apply the generated diffs in one click!

reptclip.defaultInclude.markdownDescription: Default value for the **Files to include** field on a project that has no saved ReptClip state yet.

reptclip.defaultExclude.markdownDescription: Default value for the **Files to exclude** field on a project that has no saved ReptClip state yet.

reptclip.defaultClipboard.markdownDescription: Whether **Copy to clipboard** is checked by default on a project that has no saved ReptClip state yet.

reptclip.defaultProjectStructure.markdownDescription: Whether the **Project structure** section is checked by default on a project that has no saved ReptClip state yet.

reptclip.defaultDiffFormat.markdownDescription: Whether the **Output format** section is checked by default on a project that has no saved ReptClip state yet.

reptclip.defaultFiles.markdownDescription: Whether the **Files** section is checked by default on a project that has no saved ReptClip state yet.

reptclip.defaultPromptTail.markdownDescription: Whether the **Prompt** section is checked by default on a project that has no saved ReptClip state yet.

reptclip.defaultOutputFile.markdownDescription: Default value for the **Output file** field on a project that has no saved ReptClip state yet.

reptclip.allowProtectedFileWrites.markdownDescription: Allow applying diffs that write paths ReptClip refuses by default: anything inside `.git` (git executes content from there) and `.env` / `.env.*` files. When enabled, each such apply asks for confirmation.
